g.text: Cell: positive / measured pairs. Color: signed count imbalance; ties neutral.
Blank = unmeasured. Direction is not effect size or benefit.
Each block has its own intervention and sampling protocol. Exact signed means, ties, and source keys are in metric_inventory.csv.
